summary: All three named repairs verified by execution rather than trust, and S31V3-01 I proved side by side: the identical mutation gives the v3 checker a KeyError traceback and the v4 checker a typed 'FAIL - S31-1: BOUND item has no supplier'. S31V3-02's disclosure is present and its claim is true at the bytes -- resolve() still tests key presence only. S31V3-CX-A1 is fully repaired: all four verdict tokens are the exact uppercase enum and zero lowercase occurrences remain. Ten mutation cases fail closed, a path-level diff shows REMOVED 0, and the apparent losses in failsWhen are list-shift artifacts from inserting the new entry at index 1, which I traced item by item. Both advisories share one root: this generation has not consumed adopted D-044, which landed at afc0990 between v4's authoring and this review. Its recordedInputs is byte-identical across v2, v3 and v4 while two of its three pins have since moved, against the artifact's own clause 'If a cited file moves, re-measure'; and D-044 gave DR-004 -- one of this instrument's two register rows -- a freeze §3.1 SEGMENT pin, while the instrument still gates that same section on the freeze whole-file digest.

objections.claim: recordedInputs has been carried forward byte-identical across three generations while two of its three pins moved. The artifact states the rule it is breaking.
evidence: recordedInputs is identical in v2, v3 and v4: freeze e809d439…, COORD 54d34099…, file 08 877e36d3…. I extracted and compared all three generations.
Live values: freeze e809d439… (unchanged, correct), COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md 3aec906fb60dbb6fabc1… , file 08 80fc55d1c54b1fd508eb… . Two of three are stale.

The file-08 pin was superseded by D-044 itself, adopted at afc0990, which rewrote DR-004's, DR-005's, DR-006's, DR-011's and DR-012's source-pin cells and DR-001's scope clause. The COORD pin 54d34099 predates D-039 through D-044.
The artifact's own remeasurementClause reads: 'If a cited file moves, re-measure. A moved freeze is ENVIRONMENT; the checker fails closed until this table is re-pinned by a successor.'
objections.whatThisIsNot: This does not produce a wrong answer and I am not treating it as one. The checker gates only on the freeze digest, which has not moved, so the baseline PASS is correct and coverage is unaffected. These pins are provenance, not gates -- the checker never reads them.
objections.whyItMattersAnyway: This instrument exists to make stale supplier pins visible; theErrorThisExistsToPrevent is 'Conflating a successor still exists with the item's supplier selector still exists'. Carrying its own environment pins unchanged through three generations, two of them now superseded, is the same conflation applied to itself. The COORD pin in particular has never been re-measured across the whole v2-to-v4 lineage, so a reader reconstructing what environment this table was built against gets an answer six adopted decisions out of date.
objections.remedy: Re-measure the three recordedInputs entries, or state expressly that they are authoring-time values not re-measured at this generation and why that is acceptable.

objections.claim: The instrument gates freeze §3.1 on the freeze WHOLE-FILE digest, while adopted D-044 gave DR-004 -- one of this instrument's two register rows -- a §3.1 SEGMENT pin for the same section. The instrument now re-pins on motion the register has just established as immaterial for that row.
evidence: Post-D-044 file 08, DR-004's source-pin cell reads: 'freeze §3.1 property pin (`docs/coop/IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md`, heading `### 3.1 Phase-1A insertion — mandatory`, segment `19c6a3eb2664478a4fb340451bcd1878a0ee57bcbdb7ccafd5362c86fb02b490`); product `CD-RT-5.whatThisDecisionDoesNOTDo.phase1A`'. I recomputed that segment from lines 580-603 of the live freeze and it reproduces at 19c6a3eb….

The instrument's freezeSection31 carries path, wholeFileSha256 e809d439…, selector and itemsVerbatim. failsWhen[4] fires ENVIRONMENT on whole-file digest motion, and remeasurementClause says the checker 'fails closed until this table is re-pinned by a successor'.

The two gates diverge on exactly the case D-044 exists to handle: a freeze edit outside §3.1 moves the whole-file digest but not the §3.1 segment. The register correctly does not re-open DR-004; this instrument goes ENVIRONMENT and demands a successor generation.
v4 mentions D-044 zero times and D-043 zero times, and its file-08 pin is the pre-D-044 value, so it was authored without the rewrite in view.
objections.whyItMatters: This is the treadmill D-033 named and D-044 just ended for the register: an immaterial whole-document move forcing a re-pin. Adopted D-044 performed the conversion for DR-004 specifically, and the Lane R instrument serving DR-004 still runs the superseded form on the same section. The cost is concrete and recurring -- every freeze move outside §3.1 forces a v5, v6 and so on, with a full review cycle each, while the row those generations serve would not have re-opened.
objections.itIsStrictNotWrong: The divergence is in the safe direction: the instrument fails closed where the register would not re-open, so it never falsely passes. That is why this is an advisory and not a blocker, and it is also why v4 cannot be faulted for authoring order -- D-044 adopted after these bytes were frozen.
objections.remedy: In a successor, pin freeze §3.1 by the segment the register now cites -- heading delimiter plus segment sha256 19c6a3eb… under D-044's extraction rule -- keeping itemsVerbatim as the item-level check, so ENVIRONMENT fires on §3.1 motion rather than on any freeze motion. If the whole-file gate is deliberate belt-and-braces, say so and say why the instrument holds a stricter gate than the row it serves.

verdictNote: ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES. The fold is honest and complete: all three named repairs land, the one that mattered most is proved by running the identical mutation against both generations, nothing was removed, and ten mutations fail closed. Neither advisory produces a wrong answer, and neither is a criticism of authoring order -- D-044 adopted at afc0990 after these bytes were frozen, so v4 could not have consumed it. But both are now true of the bytes under review, and they are the same defect twice: an instrument whose subject is pin honesty is carrying three-generation-old environment pins against its own re-measure rule, and is gating freeze §3.1 on a whole-file digest that adopted D-044 has just replaced with a segment pin on this instrument's own register row. The second is the more consequential, because it puts this instrument back on the treadmill the register just stepped off.
